prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Last spring I was in Chongqing for a work thing, and we ended up talking way too much about where to eat there.
Later on, I also spent a weekend in Suzhou and kept hearing people rave about the local shows and theater scene.
For that Chongqing trip, our group meal was at Liuyishou Hotpot, and it was honestly chaos in the best way.
I remember it clearly because it was on 2025-03-06, and they set us for 14:00 even though it felt like an oddly late lunch.
There were 9 of us, and my coworker Feng Jie was the contact person on it — her phone was 13898776655.
In Suzhou, my friend Sun Lei had already gotten a single ticket for Kunqu Opera Peony Pavilion, First Floor seats, and the number he used was 13830018365.
